title: A specified finite etale generic field extension spreads with compatible fibre maps
statement: Let $S$ be an irreducible scheme with generic point $\eta_S$, let $f:X\to S$ be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-fibre-product], and let $L$ be a field with a finite etale map $y_\eta:\operatorname{Spec}L\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta_S)$ [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Write $G=X_{\eta_S}\times_{\kappa(\eta_S)}\operatorname{Spec}L$. There exist a scheme $T$, an etale map $g:T\to S$, a generic point $\eta$ of $T$ mapping to $\eta_S$, and a scheme morphism $a:G\to P=X\times_S T$ whose underlying map is an embedding and whose range is exactly the fibre of $P\to T$ at $\eta$. For every field $E$ and $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$ there are $z_L:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ and an isomorphism $e:P_\eta\times_{\kappa(\eta)}\operatorname{Spec}E\simeq G\times_L\operatorname{Spec}E$, with $e$ followed by projection to $G$ and $a$ equal to the geometric fibre inclusion into $P$. No closed subset, finite type hypothesis on $f$, or conclusion about nongeneric fibres is included.

proof.text: Apply the etale generic residue-field model to obtain T, g, eta and a compatible isomorphism r from Spec kappa(eta) to Spec L. This proves etaleness, genericity and the image of eta.

Use pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso to identify the supplied generic fibre G with the pullback of f along y_eta followed by the canonical point of S, and the fibre of X times_S T over eta with the pullback of f along the canonical point of T followed by g. The compatibility for r identifies these pullbacks using pullback.map with identity maps and r.inv. Their composite is q:G isomorphic to the fibre over eta. Set a=q.hom followed by the fibre inclusion. Its underlying map is an embedding, and surjectivity of q.hom plus range_fiberι gives its range exactly.

The pullback projection equation for q reads q.hom followed by the residue-field projection equals the projection of G followed by r.inv. Cancel q.hom to obtain the inverse equation. For an arbitrary field-valued z put z_L=z followed by r.hom. The pullback.map induced by q.inv, the identity on Spec E and r.hom is an isomorphism e. The first-projection equation of this pullback map and q.inv followed by q.hom equal to identity give the claimed equality into X times_S T. No point of G is chosen, so empty X is covered.

proof_origin.note: G1: the remaining spreading construction is isolated independently of X. The fibre embedding and arbitrary field-base-change compatibility are proved in Lean using pullback pasting, pullback.map, range_fiberι and isomorphism identities.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compatible_etale_generic_fibre_model {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IrreducibleSpace S] (f : X ⟶ S)
    {L : Type u} [Field L]
    (yη : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶
      Spec (CommRingCat.of (S.residueField (genericPoint S))))
    [IsFinite yη] [Etale yη] :
    ∃ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (η : T)
      (a : pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) yη ⟶ pullback f g),
      Etale g ∧ IsGenericPoint η Set.univ ∧ g η = genericPoint S ∧
      IsEmbedding a ∧ Set.range a = (pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹' {η} ∧
      ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E)
        (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField η))),
        ∃ (zL : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
          (e : pullback ((pullback.snd f g).fiberToSpecResidueField η) z ≅
            pullback (pullback.snd (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) yη) zL),
          e.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ zL ≫ a =
            pullback.fst _ z ≫ (pullback.snd f g).fiberι η
